newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil airport to get new passenger terminal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil airport to get new passenger terminal.

text.p: Brazilian airport operator Infraero and construction firm Construtora Better SA have signed a 32 million reais ($30.8 million) contract to build a new passenger terminal at the international airport in the southern city of Porto Alegre, Infraero said in a statement.

The works at the Salgado Filho airport are to begin early next year as soon as Infraero has signed agreements worth another 30 million reais ($28.8 million) with the state of Rio Grande do Sul and the city of Porto Alegre to install a modern airport complex.
